DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご家族の口座についてのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to discuss a family member's account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 父が亡くなりました。父がこちらの銀行を使っていたので、今後の相談先を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 亡父の口座について相談先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My father has passed away. He used this bank, so I would like to know whom to consult about what to do next.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whom to consult about your late father's account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 専用の担当へおつなぎします。通帳など、お分かりになる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will put you in touch with the dedicated representative. Do you have any documents you can identify, such as a passbook?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 父の通帳が手元にあります。私自身の口座ではないので、父のカードで操作はしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通帳を保管し本人カードで操作していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have my father's passbook with me. This is not my own account, so I have not used his card to make any transactions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are keeping the passbook and have not used the account holder's card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通帳を見つけたことも、担当へお伝えください。手続きの条件は、担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also tell the representative that you found the passbook. They will check the requirements for the procedures.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。弟もいます。私が来たから一人で全部決められると思わず、家族で何を準備するか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 弟もいるため家族の準備を担当へ聞きたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I also have a younger brother. Rather than assuming I can decide everything alone because I came here, I want to ask what our family needs to prepare.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you also have a younger brother and want to ask the representative what the family should prepare. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な確認や書類について、ご案内を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please ask them to explain the necessary checks and documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日、預金を引き出すつもりで来たのではありません。まず相談の予約と、次に持ってくる物を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本日は引出しでなく予約と持ち物相談を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I did not come here intending to withdraw money today. First, I would like to arrange a consultation and find out what to bring next time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that today you want to discuss an appointment and what to bring, rather than make a withdrawal. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご用件を担当へお伝えします。連絡できる方も、確認させていただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will relay that to the representative. We will also confirm whom we can contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私の連絡先を伝えます。弟にも今日相談を始めたと知らせ、担当の説明を家族で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人の連絡先を示し家族へ相談開始を共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will give you my contact details. I will also tell my brother that I started the consultation today, and I would like our family to go over the representative's explanation together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give your own contact details and say you will share with your family that the consultation has started. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、専用の担当へご案内します。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I will now direct you to the dedicated representative. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 店内で、何かお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for something in the store?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 入口の品出しの求人を見ました。応募を考えているのですが、担当の方への連絡先を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入口の品出し求人への応募連絡先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I saw the shelf-stocking job advertisement at the entrance. I am considering applying; could you give me the contact details for the person in charge?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for the application contact for the shelf-stocking job advertised at the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 募集の案内に採用担当の番号があります。ご希望の時間帯はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The recruitment notice has the recruitment representative's number. Do you have preferred working hours?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昼は日本語の授業があるので、夕方から週三日を希望しています。その時間で応募できるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 授業があるため夕方週三日の応募可否を聞きたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have Japanese classes during the day, so I would like to work from the evening, three days a week. I want to ask whether I can apply for those hours.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that because of classes, you want to ask whether you can apply to work evenings three days a week. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 時間や日数は、採用担当へご確認ください。募集の紙を一枚お持ちいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the hours and number of days with the recruitment representative. You may take one copy of the job notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。仕事の経験は少ないので、品出しでどんな作業をするかも先に質問したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 経験が少なく仕事内容も応募前に聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I have little work experience, so I would also like to ask what shelf stocking involves before I apply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have little experience and want to ask about the work before applying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 仕事内容についても、その番号でご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can also call that number to ask about the work.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号を控えました。今日の授業が終わったら、案内にある受付時間の間に電話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号と受付時間を確認し授業後に電話する予定を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have written down the number. After my class finishes today, I will call during the contact hours listed in the notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the number and contact hours, and explain that you plan to call after class. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 面接や必要な持ち物は、担当からの案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please follow the representative's instructions about interviews and what you need to bring.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。希望の時間と経験を伝え、応募の方法を聞いてから履歴書などを用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 勤務希望経験を伝え応募方法確認後に書類を準備する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will explain my preferred hours and experience, ask how to apply, and then prepare my resume and other documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will explain your preferred work hours and experience, confirm the application process, and then prepare the documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、募集の案内をお持ちください。ご応募について担当へご相談ください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take the recruitment notice and contact the representative about applying. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 芝生の辺りで、何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having a problem near the lawn?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 補聴器を落としたようです。草刈りの車が来たので、探す場所について管理の方に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 芝生で補聴器を落とし草刈り前の捜索を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I think I dropped my hearing aid. A lawn-mowing vehicle has arrived, so I would like to ask the management staff about where I can search.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you dropped your hearing aid on the lawn and ask about searching before mowing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 車には近づかないでください。作業担当へお知らせします。最後に使っていた場所はどこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not go near the vehicle. I will notify the work crew. Where were you last using it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: このベンチから芝生の縁へ歩いた所です。耳に付けていた物が今はなく、かばんも確かめました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最後の歩行範囲と所持品確認済みを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I walked from this bench to the edge of the lawn. What I was wearing on my ear is now missing, and I have checked my bag too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe where you last walked and explain that you have already checked your belongings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 探す範囲を担当と確認します。小さい物でしたら、特徴も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the search area with the staff. If it is small, please also describe its features.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 肌色で、耳の後ろへ付ける形です。聞こえにくくなっているので、話しかける時は顔を見せてもらえると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 補聴器の特徴と顔を見せた説明の希望を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is skin-colored and fits behind the ear. I am having trouble hearing now, so it would help if you let me see your face when you speak to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the hearing aid and ask the speaker to show their face when explaining things. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。顔を見てお伝えします。作業の区域へはまだ入らずお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. I will face you when I speak. Please wait without entering the work area yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここで待ちます。友人も一緒に探したがっていますが、草刈りの車を自分たちで止めには行きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人にも作業区域へ入らず案内待ちを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wait here. My friend also wants to help search, but we will not try to stop the mowing vehicle ourselves.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell your friend too to stay out of the work area and wait for guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が探せる場所をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff will show you where you can search.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。見つかった場合も踏まないよう、先に場所を知らせます。落とした辺りを友人にも地図で示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発見位置を知らせ落下範囲を友人へ示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. If we find it, we will first let you know where it is so it does not get stepped on. I will also show my friend on a map roughly where I dropped it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will report where it is found and show your friend the area where you dropped it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、作業担当へ確認してきます。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23220-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will go and check with the work crew now. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 帰りの列車をお調べですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you checking the train for your return trip?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夕方の集まりへ行く前に、帰れるか確認したいです。この駅を出る最後の列車は何時ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夕方行事前に最終列車時刻を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Before I go to an evening gathering, I want to check whether I can get home. What time is the last train leaving this station?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the last train time before attending an evening event. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日の案内では二十一時十五分です。集まりは何時に終わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: According to today's information, it is at 9:15 p.m. What time does the gathering finish?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 終わりは二十一時の予定です。会場から駅までは歩いて二十分かかります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 行事終了時刻と駅まで二十分を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is scheduled to finish at 9 p.m. It takes twenty minutes to walk from the venue to the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the event's finishing time and the twenty-minute walk to the station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのままですと、列車の出発後に駅へ着くことになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: With that schedule, you would reach the station after the train has departed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、最後まで残れませんね。途中で帰ることを主催者へ先に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 間に合わず途中退出の連絡を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I cannot stay until the end. I will tell the organizer beforehand that I will leave partway through.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Recognize that you would miss the train and decide to notify the organizer that you will leave early. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 余裕を持って駅へ戻る時刻も、お考えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also consider when to return to the station with time to spare.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二十時四十分には会場を出たいです。早めに戻って、発車案内を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二十時四十分退出と余裕ある帰駅を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to leave the venue by 8:40 p.m. I will return early and check the departure information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will leave at 8:40 p.m. and return to the station with time to spare. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 時刻が変わる案内が出た場合も、ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check for any notices of timetable changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 出掛ける前と戻った時の両方で確認します。帰りを決めてから参加するので、時刻を教えてもらえて助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 前後で発車案内確認をすると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check both before going out and when I return. I am deciding how to get home before attending, so knowing the time has been helpful.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the departure information both before and afterward. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご予定に合わせてお出掛けください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please head out according to your plans. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住宅について、今日はどのようなお尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to ask about housing today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 父の家が空き家になっています。父は遠方に住んでいて、今日は私だけで相談先を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 父所有空家の相談先を家族として尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My father's house is vacant. My father lives far away, and I came on my own today to find out whom to consult.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: As a family member, ask whom to consult about a vacant house owned by your father. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 所有者の代わりに手続きをなさるのではなく、まず相談のご案内ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you are first asking for consultation information, rather than carrying out procedures on the owner's behalf?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。売るか残すかはまだ決まっていません。私に決定権があるということではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未決定で代理決定権を主張しないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. We have not decided whether to sell it or keep it. I am not saying that I have the authority to decide.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that no decision has been made and that you are not claiming authority to decide on his behalf. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 相談担当へ、現状を伝えられる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have any materials that can help explain the current situation to the consultation representative?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家の住所を控えてきました。室内の写真は父の許可を得て持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 住所と父許可済写真の持参を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have written down the house's address. I brought photographs of the inside with my father's permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you brought the address and photographs with your father's permission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 詳しい相談で何が必要かは、担当へご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check with the representative what you will need for a detailed consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 必要な物と、父本人が話す必要があるかを尋ねます。今日ここで契約を進めるつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 必要資料と本人対応の要否を担当へ問う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ask what to bring and whether my father needs to speak to them himself. I do not intend to proceed with a contract here today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask the representative about the necessary materials and whether the owner needs to participate himself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、こちらの住宅相談担当へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will direct you to the housing consultation representative here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 住宅相談ですね。父には窓口名と必要な準備を持ち帰って説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 窓口と準備を父へ持帰ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Housing consultation, understood. I will take back the name of the service desk and the preparations needed, and explain them to my father.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will take the service desk information and preparations back to your father. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ相談の目的をお伝えしました。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have told the representative the purpose of your consultation. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 待合のお席で、お困りのことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having any difficulties with your seat in the waiting room?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 冷房の風が直接当たって寒いです。風が当たりにくい席へ移ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冷房直風の寒さで席変更を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The air conditioning is blowing directly on me, and I am cold. May I move to a seat where the airflow is less direct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to change seats because the direct air-conditioning airflow is making you cold. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 窓際の空いた席でしたら、直接の風が当たりにくいです。お掛けいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The empty seat by the window is less exposed to direct airflow. You may sit there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 窓際へ移ります。廊下へ出て待つより、ここなら呼ばれた時にも分かりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 呼名を聞ける待合内窓側へ移ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will move by the window. If I stay here instead of waiting out in the hallway, I think I will notice when I am called.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will move to the window side inside the waiting room, where you can hear your name called. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今は、何のご案内をお待ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: What are you currently waiting for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 診察です。受付は済んでいて、呼ばれるのを待っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 診察待ちで受付済みを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: A medical consultation. I have already checked in and am waiting to be called.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have checked in and are waiting for your medical consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 移っても、診察をお待ちの状況は変わりません。体調について、伝えたいこともありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Moving seats will not change your status as waiting for your consultation. Is there anything about how you are feeling that you want to tell us?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今は風が寒く感じるということです。上着もありますので、移った席で着て待ちたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 寒く感じることと持参上着を着て待ちたい希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: At the moment, it is the airflow that feels cold. I also have a jacket, so I would like to put it on and wait in the new seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you feel cold and want to wear the jacket you brought while waiting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、荷物をお持ちになって移ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please take your belongings with you when you move.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: かばんと上着を持ちました。隣の席に広げず、一席に座ります。風が避けられ、呼び出しも聞けるのでここで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物を回収し一席で風を避け呼名を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have my bag and jacket. I will sit in one seat without spreading my things over the seat beside me. I will wait here because I can avoid the airflow and still hear when I am called.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Collect your belongings, avoid the airflow while using just one seat, and wait to be called. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お席のご希望を確認できました。それでは、お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have confirmed your seating preference. Please take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物をなくされたのですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人の車だと思い、開いていた後部ドアから車内の座席へ袋を置きました。でもその車が出た後、友人はまだ来ていないと分かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人と誤認した車へ袋を置いた経緯を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought it was my friend's car and put a bag on a seat through the open rear door. But after the car drove off, I found out my friend had not arrived yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain how you put your bag in a car you mistook for your friend's. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見知らぬ車へ、ご自分で置いた可能性があるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you may have put it in a stranger's car yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。盗まれたところを見たわけではありません。白い車を取り違えたようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 盗難目撃でないと区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I did not actually see it being stolen. I seem to have mistaken one white car for another.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Make clear that you did not witness a theft. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 置いた場所と時間を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me where and when you put it there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 駅前の乗降場所で、午後二時ごろです。番号は見ておらず、車種も分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 乗降場所と時刻と車番不明を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It was at the passenger pickup and drop-off area in front of the station, around 2 p.m. I did not see the license plate number, and I do not know the model either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the pickup and drop-off location, the time, and that the license plate number is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋の中身と、袋の特徴はどうでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: What was in the bag, and what does the bag look like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 赤い布袋に作業着が一着です。名前を縫い付けた上着も入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 赤布袋と名前入り作業上着を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is a red cloth bag containing one set of work clothes. There is also a jacket with my name sewn onto it inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the red cloth bag and the work jacket bearing your name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 状況を詳しく伺います。車を追ったり、似た車を開けたりしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will ask you for the details. Please do not chase the car or open similar-looking cars.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 追い掛けていません。このまま見たことだけ説明します。友人には、荷物を別の車へ置いた可能性を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 追跡せず事実説明と友人への連絡を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have not chased it. I will just explain what I saw. I will tell my friend that I may have put my belongings in a different car.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have not pursued the car, will explain the facts, and will contact your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お話を記録する窓口へご案内します。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will direct you to the desk that will record your account. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 郵便物をお出しになるご用件でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to send mail?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日は仕事についてのお尋ねです。掲示の求人を見ましたが、運転免許を持っていません。車を運転しない仕事もあるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 郵便発送でなく免許なしの非運転求人を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Today I have a question about work. I saw the job advertisement, but I do not have a driving license. I would like to know whether there are jobs that do not involve driving a vehicle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about non-driving vacancies for someone without a license, rather than sending mail. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 募集の仕事内容は採用担当へ確認します。仕分けなどのお仕事に関心がおありですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the advertised job duties with the recruitment representative. Are you interested in work such as sorting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 仕分けに興味があります。車を運転しない募集を探しているので、その仕事の内容を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 免許不要の仕事として仕分けの内容に関心があると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am interested in sorting. I am looking for a vacancy that does not involve driving, so I would like to ask what that job involves.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your interest in the duties of sorting as a job that does not require a driving license. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 運転の有無だけでなく、それぞれの募集条件をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check each vacancy's requirements, as well as whether it involves driving.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 仕分けでは、重い物を持つ作業もありますか。応募する前に、どの程度の重さを扱うか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 仕分けで扱う荷物の重さを応募前に確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Does sorting involve lifting heavy items too? Before applying, I would like to know how much weight I would handle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to check the weight of parcels handled in sorting before applying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 仕事内容へのご質問として、担当へお伝えいただけます。勤務の希望はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can ask the representative that as a question about the duties. Have you decided your preferred working hours?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 平日の午後を希望しています。午後の募集があるかも、担当の方に聞いてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 平日午後の希望を示しその時間帯の募集があるか聞きたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would prefer weekday afternoons. I will also ask the representative whether there are afternoon vacancies.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State your preference for weekday afternoons and say you want to ask whether there are vacancies during those hours. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらが採用の問い合わせ先です。窓口で採用が決まることはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is the recruitment contact. Hiring decisions are not made at this counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連絡先を控えました。免許がないこと、仕分けへの関心、作業の重さと午後の希望を担当へ聞いてから応募を考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 採用連絡先を控え免許職種作業負担時間を確認後応募検討する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have written down the contact details. I will tell the representative that I do not have a license, and ask about my interest in sorting, the weight of the work, and my preference for afternoons before considering an application.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Note the recruitment contact and say you will consider applying after checking the license issue, job type, physical load, and hours. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ募集の内容をご確認ください。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the details of the vacancy. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この通帳について、どのお手続きでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to do with this passbook?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 記帳をしたいです。でも今見ると、使い終わった古い通帳を持ってきたようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 記帳希望と旧通帳の誤持参を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to update it. But looking at it now, I seem to have brought an old passbook that has already been used up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to update your passbook but mistakenly brought the old one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後のページに繰越済みの表示がありますね。新しい通帳はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The last page is marked as having been carried forward to a new passbook. Do you have the new passbook with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家の引き出しにあります。古い方を捨てずに置いていたので、間違えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現行通帳は自宅と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is in a drawer at home. I kept the old one instead of throwing it away, so I mixed them up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the current passbook is at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この古い通帳へ、新しい取引の記帳はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: New transactions cannot be entered in this old passbook.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 新しい方を持って出直します。古い記録も必要なので、これは持ち帰って別に保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現行持参で再訪し旧記録保管を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will come back with the new one. I need the old records too, so I will take this home and keep it separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will return with the current passbook and retain the old records. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 新しい通帳を、なくされたわけではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: You have not lost the new passbook, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: なくしていません。昨日は家で見ました。今日は紛失の届けではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現行通帳の紛失でないと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not lost it. I saw it at home yesterday. I am not reporting a loss today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Make clear that the current passbook is not lost. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、こちらをお返しします。次は現在ご使用の通帳をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will return this to you, then. Next time, please bring the passbook you currently use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受け取りました。家で繰越済みかどうかを見て、今の通帳を選んで持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 繰越表示を見て正しい通帳を持参すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have it back. At home I will check whether the passbook is marked as carried forward, choose the current one, and bring it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the carried-forward marking and bring the correct passbook. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お手数をお掛けします。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for taking the trouble. Please have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 飲料の箱をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for cases of beverages?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場の行事で、同じ水を十二箱使います。棚から全部取る前に、そろうか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 行事用同じ水十二箱の在庫可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: We will use twelve cases of the same water for an event at work. Before taking everything off the shelves, I would like to check whether you can supply that many.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether twelve cases of the same water are available for an event. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この棚には四箱あります。ほかの在庫は担当に確認します。いつお使いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are four cases on this shelf. I will ask the representative about other stock. When do you need them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 来週の金曜日です。今日持ち帰る必要はありませんが、その日までに用意できるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 来週金曜使用で本日持帰不要と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Next Friday. I do not need to take them home today, but I want to know whether they can be ready by that day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you need them next Friday and do not need to take them home today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 数量と受取の希望を担当へお伝えします。注文が確定したわけでは、まだありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will relay the quantity and your pickup preferences to the representative. The order is not confirmed yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。四箱を先に買うと、残りがそろわない場合に困るので、今日は買わずに回答を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 注文未確定を理解し四箱先行購入を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. If I buy four cases first and the rest cannot be supplied, that would be a problem, so I will not buy any today and will wait for the answer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that the order is unconfirmed and avoid buying the four cases ahead of time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご連絡先を伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: May I have your contact details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私の携帯です。職場には購入できるとまだ言わず、在庫を確認していると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 携帯連絡先と職場に確認中と伝える予定を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here is my mobile number. I will tell my workplace that I am checking stock, rather than saying yet that we can buy them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give your mobile contact details and say you will tell your workplace that stock is being checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 価格や受取方法も、担当からの回答でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also confirm the price and pickup method in the representative's reply.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 全部でいくらになるかと、一度に受け取れるかも聞きたいです。返事をもらってから、職場の担当に購入の了承を取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 総額一括受取を確認後職場承認を取ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I would also like to ask how much the total will be and whether I can pick up everything at once. After I receive the reply, I will get approval for the purchase from the person in charge at work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will confirm the total cost and collection all at once, then obtain workplace approval. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望を担当へ渡します。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass your request to the representative. Goodbye.
